_comment_1: Copy the 'mcpServers' block below (just that block, merged into your existing config — don't overwrite anything else already there) into your actual Claude Desktop config.
_comment_2: Easiest way to find/open the right file: in Claude Desktop, go to Settings -> Developer -> Edit Config. That opens the exact file for your OS/install, so you don't have to guess the path by hand.
_comment_3: If editing by hand instead: on Windows it's typically %APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json. Claude Desktop runs on the Windows side even though your project lives in WSL, so 'command' below launches wsl.exe to bridge into your Linux environment where python3/kavach actually live.
_comment_4: Restart Claude Desktop completely (not just close the window) after editing, or the new server won't load.
